family_reports.body: It has caused me to miss out on every milestone my children have had.…
For more than three years, the actions taken through the Elkhart County family court…
It has alienated my sons from me. My rapist has custody of my children…
I’ve been harmed by a system where subjective interpretation carried more power than verified…
